reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: The Fund has a first close in December 2021. MASSIF, a Dutch government fund managed by FMO, intends to commit USD 10mln to the Fund, helping it reach a final size closer to its target and ensuring the viability of the investment strategy and sustainability of the manager. The Fund’s investment strategy is well aligned with MASSIF’s objective of supporting early-stage companies in frontier markets, and to support businesses that improve the livelihood and access to basic services for low-income households/consumers.
